summary: Pitanium Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, announcing the launch of two new product lines (Pi-ology and Pi-Formance) under its Pitanium brand, along with an update on its ongoing trading halt and responses to information requests from Nasdaq, the SEC, and FINRA. The filing is a routine business update regarding product introductions and regulatory correspondence; it contains no special-situation M&A, activist, restructuring, or other transformative corporate event. The registrant is a foreign private issuer reporting under Rule 13a-16, and the disclosure is furnished, not filed.
